task.question: Can any frozen five-line construction strategy repeatedly outperform same-target random five-line bundles?
task.novelty: Seven distinct five-line strategies plus a nested trailing-200 dynamic selector are compared with 100 random five-line bundles on identical targets.

spec.research_question: Can any frozen five-line construction strategy repeatedly outperform same-target random five-line bundles?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: Candidate bank uses target t-1 only; nested dynamic selector uses exactly the prior 200 completed target outcomes to choose among frozen strategies.
spec.primary_metric: five-line max hits, any_3plus, any_4plus, and winning-number union coverage
spec.comparator: same-target 100-random-five-line baseline; fixed seven strategies and nested 200-target selector
spec.baseline: 100 target-seeded portfolios of five distinct uniform six-number lines per target
spec.multiplicity_correction: Construction strategy comparisons are exploratory; promotion gate pre-registers only nested selector any_3plus and max_hits.
spec.tie_break: strategy-specific frozen rule; lexical model/candidate order for remaining ties
spec.novelty_signature: five-line strategies top5/min/mid/high overlap/source diversity/independent centered/B-independent mix; nested trailing-200 selector; 100 same-target RANDOM_5_LINES bundles
